prospective_decision_rule.dominance: Treatment lower 95 percent bootstrap bound for one category share exceeds 0.50 in at least one marker-sensitive condition and no other category lower bound exceeds 0.50 there
prospective_decision_rule.interpretation_limit: descriptive error morphology only; does not establish a causal training mechanism
prospective_decision_rule.mixed_or_inconclusive: no single category qualifies, conditions disagree, taxonomy is non-exclusive, or identities/groupings are incomplete

required_reports: counts and shares of all categories by condition and arm
48-base paired Treatment-versus-Control and Treatment-versus-V7 category transitions as descriptive evidence
parser-invalid and non-oracle structural failures separately
statistical_unit: canonical base; retain all four marker-turn views together

taxonomy.CORRECT_MAPPING: all four marker-turn outputs equal their respective desired targets
taxonomy.MARKER_INVARIANT_LEGAL_ROTATION: otherwise, all four outputs are legal target-family grids but canonicalize to one identical grid
taxonomy.MARKER_RESPONSIVE_WRONG_MAPPING: otherwise, outputs contain at least two distinct legal target-family grids but the four-turn mapping is not fully correct
taxonomy.STRUCTURAL_OR_FORMAT_FAILURE: otherwise, at least one output is parser-invalid or matches none of the four legal turn-specific target grids
